pr_title: Bluetooth: Mesh: Fix unable sent mesh message
pr_body:
In PR (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/58723) has introduce another bug, that, the flag `ADV_FLAG_PROXY` set before actually enabled.

When ctx:: BT RX call `schedule_send` will atomic_test_and_clear `ADV_FLAG_PROXY`, but at this time, the proxy advertising will not at advertising state, maybe in update params or set adverting data phase,

so that, call `bt_le_ext_adv_stop` will nothing, and then call `k_work_reschedule` --> `send_pending_adv`(at this time, the proxy advertising actually enabled, but the upper layer clear proxy flags), cause latest advertising unable start, because unable in advertising state to update params(`-EINVAL`).

Fixes: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/58721

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Mesh: Unable send mesh message

review_comments: Would it make sense to clear `ADV_FLAG_PROXY_START` before calling `bt_le_ext_adv_stop`? E.g. if connection happens during scheduling that is caused by `bt_le_ext_adv_stop` (not sure if this possible though)? This would prevent from calling `schedule_send` from `connected` callback.
